approval_policy: Proposals stay private; applying to live state requires explicit Master authorization. Player decisions are never generated as facts.

components.scope_rule: Owner controls own sheet; Master has administrative tools. Missing damage is an unavailable mode, never invented damage.
components.extension: Discover real attacks, abilities, counters and inventory before producing a test case. Use level-derived stats and pending-roll state.

components.scope_rule: Preview is not damage application. Confirm once; recover receipts after network failures. Do not grant extra attacks.
components.extension: Reuse preview/confirm for new attacks and generated tests; do not implement damage in React.

components.scope_rule: Main action, consumable slot and movement are distinct. Exploration turns are not combat rounds.
components.extension: Test consumption, duration, expiry, source stacking, zero HP and retries through native transactions.

components.scope_rule: structured is not proof of automation. Separate approved, assisted, unavailable and blocked rules.
components.extension: Existing PDF catalog has a first reviewed source batch through catalog_provenance.py. Source verification is not campaign approval or native execution. Extend in small attributed batches, never infer damage from the first dice in prose.

components.scope_rule: Creating a catalogue item is not granting it. Hidden loot is private until revealed. Consumables are finite.
components.extension: Use existing effects, equipment slots, charges and inventory rules; distinguish item versus ability and consumable versus reusable tool.

components.scope_rule: Summon uses native token, owner and turn state. Do not clone the player sheet or create duplicate active summons on retry.
components.extension: Generate tests for summon limits, resource cost, pin sheet, ownership, turn insertion, duration and dismissal.

components.scope_rule: NPC knowledge, rumors and secrets have confidence/visibility. Catalogue monster is not spawned token. Dorn stays GM controlled.
components.extension: Detailed NPC combat sheet should complement native NPC memory and token sheet, not create a third NPC database.

components.scope_rule: Background is visual; cell position is authoritative. GM reposition is not combat move. Map library remains in Maps, not central sheet.
components.extension: Use location pins and scene elements for future points of interest. Walls/LOS require separate verified cut; do not infer them from pixels.

components.scope_rule: Proposed sandbox must start as draft AND visibility=gm (default is table). Publishing/opening is a separate human-approved action.
components.extension: Reuse narrative, gm_analysis and source_refs for future alternatives and evidence. Do not predict player choices as facts or replace live scene history.

components.scope_rule: No parallel WebSocket. Technical audit differs from public narrative. TEMP rehearsal must never load live credentials or mutate live battle.
components.extension: Local MCP companion-tests exposes capabilities/start/status with structured schemas, durable request receipts and a bounded TEMP runner. OpenCode is configured; other local hosts can register the same stdio command. No live credentials, arbitrary code or RPG rule approval accepted. Private Scenes proposals link verified existing-code reports, never execute proposal JSON.

components.scope_rule: Ten approved actions: Dorn Relampago, Reflexos, Forca Arcana, Teia, Dissipar Magia; Vezemir Forca Arcana, Velocidade; Morthak Clonagem, Magia da Morte; Raziel Sangue Defensivo. Internal metadata models are not OpenAPI request schemas. Manifest binding is not complete automation or certification; execution retains existing auth/transactions/RNG/ledger/realtime.
components.extension: Reuse bounded rolls, native resource spend and revision checks inside existing handlers. No user scripts, eval or generic prose-to-damage executor.

components.scope_rule: GM only; revisions immutable; edit invalidates current review/evidence. Approval never publishes or executes. Evidence reads an existing terminal local MCP report, not client PASS.
components.extension: Agent authors private JSON with sources, intended native handler and deterministic tests; operator reviews separately. Arbitrary proposal execution and whole-library approval are not implemented.
